blender-any.clarifying_question: What would you like to animate? (e.g. a character walking, a product reveal, a logo intro)

todo.objective: A mobile or web app that lets a user create, view, and mark complete a list of personal tasks, assuming a basic single-user interface with local or cloud persistence.

capabilities.reason: need to store tasks with properties like title, completion status, and timestamps
need an authenticated backend to save and retrieve a user's tasks
need a responsive UI to display the list, add tasks, and toggle completion
need to reliably persist and restore the user's task list across sessions

knob.objective: Build a rotary knob that provides programmable haptic feedback (virtual detents, resistance, etc.) and can be read/controlled by a microcontroller.

capabilities.reason: control the motor to generate haptic forces
read the knob's absolute rotary position
design and tune the feel of virtual detents and resistance
write firmware to coordinate sensing, control, and programmability
size power supply for motor current alongside logic
design an enclosure and knob cap that houses the motor and encoder

rc-truck.clarifying_question: What do you want to build with an RC truck—are you designing the truck itself, a custom chassis, an upgrade/mod, or something else?

coaster.objective: A coaster that uses a load cell to detect and measure the weight of a drink placed on it.

capabilities.reason: need to integrate and calibrate a load cell to measure drink weight
need to write firmware to read the load cell and handle the sensing logic
need to design a schematic for the coaster PCB with load cell interface
need to layout a circular or coaster-shaped PCB that serves as the physical coaster
need to assemble the compact coaster PCB with surface-mount components

screws.objective: A device that mechanically dispenses screws one at a time, counts each dispense, and syncs the inventory count to an online database tracking all parts in stock.

capabilities.reason: dispense one screw at a time from a hopper without jamming
design the hopper, escapement mechanism and enclosure
confirm each screw was dispensed and count parts by weight
run the dispense logic, count tracking, and trigger network updates
send count updates from the device to the online database
build the server API to receive counts and serve inventory data
design the database schema tracking part types, bins, and current counts

birds.objective: Create an illustration of birds lined up on a beach, using reference images to draw recognizable bird anatomy and posture in a coastal composition.

capabilities.reason: draw birds with accurate anatomy, gesture, and arrange them in a coherent beach composition

apothecary.objective: Generate AI art of characters or scenes from The Apothecary Diaries anime/manga in a consistent style.

capabilities.reason: drive the model to match the anime's visual style and aesthetic
keep Maomao and other characters recognizable across multiple generated images
evaluate composition and pose quality to know what references and prompts will work

printed.clarifying_question: What object do you want to 3D print?

fishtank.objective: Animate a scene in Blender showing a fish (or dish on a plate) looking out from inside a fishtank in a Chinese restaurant setting.

capabilities.reason: model the fishtank, restaurant interior, and the dish/fish character
create water material for tank, glass, and restaurant lighting atmosphere
rig the character (dish or fish) for animation with controllable facial features
animate the character looking out with convincing timing and weight
frame the shot to tell the story of looking out from inside the tank
render and composite the final scene with proper depth and atmosphere

anime90s.objective: Create a 3D animation in Blender that replicates the visual style of 1990s anime, assuming a short scene with at least one character.

capabilities.reason: need to model characters and environment geometry with clean topology suitable for animation
need to rig characters with armatures for posing and animation
need to create cel-shaded materials that replicate 90s anime look with flat colors, sharp shadows, and limited gradients
need to animate characters with timing and spacing that matches 90s anime conventions
need to frame and move the camera in ways typical of 90s anime cinematography
need to composite render passes to add film grain, chromatic aberration, and other period-authentic post effects

golf-mount.objective: A 3D printed mount that attaches to a golf bag and holds an iPhone in position to record golf swings.

capabilities.reason: must measure golf bag tube/frame diameter and design clamp or attachment that fits it securely
must model the mount body and phone cradle with correct dimensions for iPhone
must keep phone stable during walking, bag movement, and cart vibration to avoid shaky footage
must choose filament that survives outdoor sun exposure and temperature swings on the course

gacha.objective: A mobile gacha game where players collect anime-style characters (waifus) and use them to cook dishes, assuming typical mechanics like character collection, cooking minigames or automation, progression systems, and monetization through character gacha pulls.

capabilities.reason: core game state and scene flow between menus, cooking, and collection screens
implement character drop rates, rarity tiers, and pity mechanics for monetization
layout and wire character collection, cooking interface, and shop screens for mobile touch
generate consistent anime-style character art for the gacha roster
keep each waifu visually consistent across card art, cooking scenes, and UI
save player's character collection, currency, and progression across sessions

gridfinity.objective: Create a Gridfinity-compatible organizer bin with custom cutouts shaped to hold specific tools (assuming hand tools like pliers, screwdrivers, or similar).

capabilities.reason: measure each tool and design cutouts that fit their profiles
model the Gridfinity base unit and custom cutout geometry
choose filament that will hold up to repeated tool insertion and removal

pokemon-bin.objective: A 3D-printed organizer for storing bulk Pokémon cards, with separate compartments sorted by card type and color (assuming standard type color coding like fire=red, water=blue, etc.)

capabilities.reason: model the compartmented storage box with dividers
design modular sections that snap together for expandable storage
create color-coded labels or color bands that clearly indicate which compartment holds which type
capabilities.resolve_why: same concept of creating color-coded labels for storage compartments

capabilities.reason: choose filament colors matching Pokémon types and ensure cards don't warp the compartments over time

ledger.objective: A mobile app that tracks a stock portfolio, showing current holdings, values, and performance.

capabilities.reason: build and ship the iOS portfolio tracker app
integrate stock price APIs to fetch current market data and valuations
design a schema to store holdings, transactions, and historical portfolio snapshots
reliably save and restore user portfolio data across sessions

verstappen.objective: Create a 3D animation of Max Verstappen's race car in motion on a track

capabilities.reason: model the F1 car with accurate proportions and details
create Red Bull Racing livery materials and realistic car paint
rig the car with controls for suspension and rotating wheels
animate the car motion with convincing speed, weight and racing behavior
animate camera movements that track and showcase the racing car dramatically
render and composite motion blur and depth of field for cinematic result

dryer.objective: A device that blows warm air to dry a person's body after a shower, eliminating the need for a towel.

capabilities.reason: must size blower(s) and heating element to deliver enough warm airflow to dry a wet human body in reasonable time
device operates in wet bathroom environment with heating elements powered by mains voltage
enclosure must survive continuous exposure to steam and water spray in a shower environment
need to design enclosure, mounting brackets, and air ducting/nozzle geometry
control heating element temperature, fan speed, and safety timeouts

gundam.objective: A robot Gundam head that detects people, tracks their position, and moves to follow them as they walk, with a transformation mechanism that changes the head's form.

capabilities.reason: model the Gundam head geometry before fabrication
design the mechanical frame, servo mounts, and transformation linkages
design a transformation mechanism with moving panels or parts that doesn't bind
detect and locate people in the camera frame in real time
convert person detections into smooth pan and tilt servo targets
drive multiple servos for pan, tilt, and transformation actuation
coordinate vision, servo sequencing, and transformation control on embedded hardware
